name: evopilot
description: A local-first workflow compiler that turns repeated AI-agent work into evidence-backed Skills and token-capped behavior policies.

interface.shortDescription: Turn repeated work into Skills and behavior policies.
interface.longDescription: EvoPilot measures privacy-minimized work outcomes, detects repeated successful workflows, compiles qualified work into portable Open Agent Skills, and promotes stable behavior fingerprints into short token-capped policy cards. Structural and semantic gates block weak Skills before exact one-time installation approval.
defaultPrompt: Run the EvoPilot 60-second workflow compiler demo.
Use EvoPilot while we work. EvoPilot is also active by default after restart in new tasks.
Show which repeated workflows are ready to become Skills.
Compile and validate my strongest proven workflow as a portable Skill bundle.
